arguments.sql:
SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND p.ID IN (
      SELECT l.ID
      FROM main.Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;
